title: 第25章 叛乱彻底平息第26章 灵植术郑灵君大寿
slug: 长生家族从十七岁成为家主开始
lines: 李行歌来到矿山的时候，矿场的暴乱已经进入了尾声。
这些大部分连武器都没有的矿奴，在无情的屠戮中，终于是熄灭了那最后一腔热血。
生还的奴隶双手抱头恐惧的跪伏在地。
一众李家修士看到自家家主的到来，皆是面露恭敬之色，齐齐弯下了腰。
而一众矿山守卫，则是单膝跪地。
同声高呼：“见过家主！”
高呼声响彻了整个矿场。
而那些被镇压的奴隶们则是开始剧烈的颤抖起来，身子匍匐在地上一动也不敢动，心中恐惧愈甚。
因为，他们的命运，便掌握在这个年轻男子的手里。
李行歌听着这漫山遍野的山呼声，早已司空见惯，心中毫无波澜。
他负着手，不急不慢的向前走着。
目光所至之处，所有人皆是低下了头，无人敢与之对视。
待走至高处，李行歌缓缓的转过了身来，场面瞬间变得鸦雀无声。
他面容平静，看不出任何的喜怒哀乐。
“你们造反，我很不高兴。”
他缓缓的开口道。
此话一出，所有的奴隶身子都是齐齐一颤，眼中一片死灰。
看来，他们今日是难逃一死了。
但李行歌接下来的话，却又让奴隶们瞬间又燃起了对生的渴望。
“原本我是想将你们全部处决的，但上天尚且有好生之德，我也不例外，我可以再给你们一次机会。”
在奴隶们期待的眼神中。
李行歌笑了，他缓缓道：“接下来，我会与你们玩一个很好玩的游戏，”
“这个游戏的规则很简单，你们将分作五人一组，各自抽签。”
“签有五支，五支签里有四支红签，一支黑签。”
“抽到红签的人只要能杀死那个抽到黑签的人，你们便能成为这个游戏的胜利者，活下去。”
“当然，抽到黑签的人也不要绝望，只要你有能力反杀其他四人，你也可以活下去，甚至，我还可以免去你们奴隶的身份。”
“不要问我为什么，因为，这是一个弱肉强食的世界。”
“强者，有活下去的资格。”
李行歌说完。
所有的奴隶呼吸都开始变得急促了起来。
原本刚刚还并肩作战的战友，此刻望向彼此的眼神中，却是充满了提防、审视与不怀好意。
一个年老的奴隶瞪大了眼睛，看着高台上那个外表俊雅的贵公子，好似看到了一个狰狞的魔鬼，想到那可怕的后果，他站起来怒吼道。
“大家都不要相信他的鬼话，如果我们真的按照他说的做了，那我们就再也没有离开这里的机会了。”
两名李家修士愤怒的冲上前去，抽出刀便准备将这个胆大包天敢冒犯家主的奴隶给处决。
却见李行歌摆了摆手。
两名修士虽然不解，但还是收住了手中的刀。
只是眼神却依旧恶狠狠的盯着那年老的奴隶。
“看来这个机会，你们不想要。”
李行歌看上去并没有生气，只是摇了摇头一脸淡漠的道。
众多奴隶看到刚得来的一线生机就要被年老奴隶给无情的掐灭。
全部纷纷怒视着他。
content_en:
When Li Xingge came to the mine, the riot in the mine was already coming to an end.
Most of these mine slaves without weapons finally extinguished their last passion in the ruthless slaughter.
The surviving slave kneeled on the ground in fear with his head in his hands.
When all the monks of the Li family saw the arrival of their master, they all looked respectful and bent down.
And all the mine guards knelt down on one knee.
They all shouted in unison: “I’ve met the master of the family!”
Shouting echoed throughout the mine.
The suppressed slaves began to tremble violently, lying on the ground without daring to move, and the fear in their hearts became even worse.
Because their fate is in the hands of this young man.
Li Xingge had long been accustomed to listening to the mountain calls that filled the mountains and plains, and his heart was completely unmoved.
He clasped his hands behind his back and walked forward unhurriedly.
Wherever they looked, everyone lowered their heads, and no one dared to look at him.
When they reached the top, Li Xingge slowly turned around, and the scene instantly became silent.
His face was calm, showing no emotion or emotion.
"I'm not happy that you're rebelling."
He spoke slowly.
As soon as these words came out, all the slaves trembled and their eyes turned gray.
It seems that they will not escape death today.
But Li Xingge's next words instantly ignited the slaves' desire for life again.
"Originally, I wanted to execute you all, but God has the virtue of a good life, and I am no exception. I can give you another chance."
In the expectant eyes of the slaves.
Li Xingge smiled and said slowly: "Next, I will play a very fun game with you."
"The rules of this game are very simple. You will be divided into groups of five and each will draw lots."
"There are five lots. Among the five lots, there are four red lots and one black lot."
"As long as the person who draws the red lottery can kill the person who draws the black lottery, you can become the winner of this game and survive."
"Of course, those who have drawn the black lottery should not despair. As long as you have the ability to kill the other four people, you can survive. I can even exempt you from your status as a slave."
"Don't ask me why, because this is a world where the jungle prevails."
"The strong have the right to live."
Li Xingge finished speaking.
All the slaves' breathing began to become rapid.
The comrades who had been fighting side by side just now were looking at each other with eyes full of caution, scrutiny and ill-intention.
An old slave stared wide-eyed, looking at the handsome and elegant young master on the high platform, as if he saw a ferocious devil. Thinking of the terrible consequences, he stood up and roared.
"Don't believe his lies. If we really do what he says, we will never have a chance to leave here."
The two Li family monks rushed forward angrily, drew their knives, and prepared to execute the slave who had the audacity to offend the family master.
But Li Xingge waved his hand.
Although the two monks were puzzled, they still put away the knives in their hands.
But his eyes were still staring at the old slave fiercely.
"It seems you don't want this opportunity."
Li Xingge didn't look angry, he just shook his head and said indifferently.
"No!"
Many slaves will be ruthlessly snuffed out by the old slaves when they see the glimmer of hope they have just gained.
Everyone glared at him.
